Anna (PM): Quick sync — we need a tightly worded one-page launch brief for Private deployments where customers control networking. Goal: what we will guarantee, what customers must do, and GA gating rules.

Raj (Eng): TL;DR from eng: non-destructive rolling upgrades, signed airgap artifacts, a prescriptive rollback procedure, and a preflight that surfaces actionable failures.

Marta (Field): Field asks: include a "customer responsibilities" lane. Must have a named network owner, confirmed ASN/IP blocks, firewall change windows, and DNS cutover slot. Also call out typical failure modes we won’t debug without netowner engagement.

Kyle (NetOps): Netops gating: require a BGP handoff dry-run that proves egress IP continuity and AS-path correctness. Installer should output egress->node mapping we can validate. If we promise IP preservation we must validate with an automated test harness.

Jia (SRE): Observability minimums: upgrade_progress, agent_version, node_egress_ips, upgrade_errors; plus an event timeline that maps operator actions to system events. Telemetry must be togglable and respect customer KMS/policy. Provide a short troubleshooting playbook for top 5 issues.

Anna (PM): Draft one-pager bullets (short):
- Preflight: network reachability, ports, kernel/disk, NAT/iptables scan, egress mapping verified
- Dry-run: BGP handoff simulation & egress continuity check (netops sign-off required)
- Upgrade: canary (configurable 10%) -> roll, non-destructive agent rollback available
- Rollback: documented steps to restore previous agent + ip mapping within target window for supported configs
- Packaging: online installer + airgap bundle (sha256-signed)
- Observability: minimal metrics + event log, telemetry opt-out + KMS-aware
- Support: contracted cutover assistance window; P1 triage SLA as agreed in contract
- Exclusions: customer BGP misconfig, physical HW failures, unsupported kernel mods

Marta (Field): Add customer responsibilities column: provide network owner contact, pre-approved ASN/IPs, firewall/IP allowlist changes, DNS TTL guidance, and an acceptance signature after dry-run. Include FAQ bullet: "What we won't own: customer-run BGP configs and legacy NATs."

Kyle (NetOps): Ill deliver the dry-run checklist and a small verifier script (bgp adj check, traceroute from probes, curl egress-ip). ETA: Tue EOD.

Raj (Eng): Ill produce preflight tooling + rollback runbook. Need to document known unsupported kernel modules. ETA: Tue EOD.

Jia (SRE): Ill draft the metrics spec and a 1-page troubleshooting playbook (with sample queries). ETA: Wed AM.

Anna (PM): GA gating proposal: require two customer-verified cutovers on different topologies before GA: one on-prem BGP handoff and one cloud VPC flow. Each must exercise rollback. Thoughts?

Marta (Field): Strong agree. Two topologies reduces regression risk — field needs this for customer comms.

Raj (Eng): Agree. Define "successful cutover": canary->full upgrade, rollback exercised, no IP drift for 48h, metrics within baseline, signed post-cutover report.

Kyle (NetOps): Add: at least one verification must be airgap or constrained-control-plane-like. Netops sign-off required for each cutover.

Anna (PM): OK. Owners: Raj owns preflight + rollback docs; Kyle owns netops dry-run; Marta owns customer responsibilities & FAQ; Jia owns metrics + runbook. Ill synthesize the one-pager once inputs are in and send for signoff. ETA for draft: Thu COB.

deploy-bot: Uploaded internal draft: /docs/private-deploy/briefs/launch-ops-brief-v1.md

Marta (Field): Noted — Ill review when you post the draft. :eyes:
